title: Kitty Snack Shop
description: Manage a cozy street-side snack shop staffed by adorable cat chefs—cook tasty treats, serve impatient kitten guests, upgrade stalls, and unlock fresh recipes.
controls: Tap orders, cooking stations, and upgrade buttons to serve adorable cat customers and grow your cozy snack bar.

zh-CN.title: 喵咪小吃铺
zh-CN.description: 超治愈猫咪美食经营小店：和胖乎乎的猫咪大厨一起制作热气腾腾的特色小吃，招待可爱的猫猫客人，升级菜单装修人气夜宵摊。
zh-CN.controls: 点击解锁灶台、升级菜品与招募小猫店员，接待源源不断的猫咪顾客赚取金币扩建小吃铺。
